title: Audit longer paired references before using 1509 herbal OCR as Latin training text
statement: Across 30 preselected prose lines on six PDF pages of the 1509 Herbarius latinus, the OCR needs 131/234 word edits (56.0%, 47.9–65.2% descriptive page-bootstrap range) and 177/1522 character edits including spaces (11.6%). Page word-edit rates span 43.6–76.9%. The two independent readings differ by 2/240 words before adjudicated line joins. The word-edit rate is 128/240 (53.3%) against either unadjudicated reading. The earlier page 21 pilot reproduces 19/30 word and 19/204 character edits. A six-entry long-s correction fitted only on page 21 removes five edits in the audit, leaving 126/234 word edits (53.8%). Errors include long-s substitutions, word fusions, line division and intruding character groups. The current OCR and this correction are insufficient for a corpus pin. The attached data preserve the aligned crops and counts.
check: Recompute both distances from the stored normalized strings, using six pages and the separate page 21 training sample. To qualify a better text, record a new disjoint fit and evaluation split, independently transcribe enough body lines to construct matched-length controls, and report fixed-budget planted-key recovery on adjudicated, corrected and raw text under identical length, key and scoring settings before adding a corpus.

protocol.sampler: Using CPython random.Random(1509), take and sort the sample of size 2 from each inclusive one-based PDF range 31–105, 125–199 and 219–293. Freeze page selection 49/66, 134/158, 221/238 before seeing images or OCR. Take the first five prose lines after any heading or engraving, left column first if applicable. No page was replaced.
protocol.alignment: Render pages to 2100 px tall with Poppler. Set left/top/right/bottom on the image around the five body lines. Scale XML WORD box centers into the raster dimensions, include centers in the crop, assign each XML LINE group's selected tokens to a physical row by its median y against the listed row cuts, and sort fragments within each row by x. Exclude headings and marginalia by the window. Blur and misplaced boxes can still contribute to the measured error.
protocol.transcription: Two readers per page use only the same scan crop, with no OCR or other transcript. Keep historical spelling, treat long s as s, expand clearly readable abbreviations, represent a visible line division stroke as a hyphen, and leave beginning and ending word fragments. On review also join six unambiguous broken words without a legible division stroke and record those joins. All reader alternatives are retained.
protocol.normalization: Join line-end hyphens across physical lines within the crop. Expand ampersands to et in all variants. Use vs.refcorpus.normalize(..., 'latin') to fold j/v, diacritics and punctuation. Unrecognized OCR marks are handled by that normalizer. Use unit-cost Levenshtein at word level and at character level including spaces. Letter-only counts exclude spaces. Denominators are the corresponding reference lengths.
protocol.uncertainty: Compute a descriptive page bootstrap by enumerating all 6^6 ordered page resamples and taking the nearest-index 0.025 and 0.975 quantiles of the pooled edit rate. This small-sample range reflects variation among the audited opening prose snippets, without estimating accuracy for a whole book or another edition. Separate OCR rates against A and B show sensitivity to reader decisions. Reader agreement is measured before the six additional joins.
protocol.separate_pilot_correction: Train on the prior P-J-035 page 21 reference and OCR strings only. For every normalized pilot OCR token absent from the pilot reference vocabulary, keep an exact-token mapping if exactly one same-length reference token differs only by one or more f-to-s substitutions. Apply this fixed table to exact normalized tokens on the six audit pages. No page used for this correction was used to evaluate it.
protocol.control_status: No matched-length fixed-budget cipher recovery was run because this correction leaves more than half of reference words edited and the manually transcribed reference is only 1294 letters. No corpus was added. Any proposed corpus should first show recovery from longer paired reference and corrected text with the same key, corruption controls, test length and budget.
